name: llmc_classifier_fused
goal: Port classifier_fused_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/classifier_fused.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> B T V` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 0.0001 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so delete it (delete_file) once your own port is done. migrate's output can be long: read it in parts (read_file offset/limit) or work from the CUDA harness.

museport.note: B=4, T=32 (llm.c: B=8, T=1024); V=2048 (llm.c: V=50257, P=50304); V multiple of 64 so P==V and no 2D unpadding needed, rows stay 16B-aligned for float4/x128; probs is scratch allocated in host_prep; deterministic 3x outlier x20 injection per row without rand() so reference and harness agree; block size 256.
